plain_english: Image 66 continues John's debts and includes the court's closing confirmation. Image 65 supplies the opening and inventory; James Carmichael reviews and confirms the testamentary material.

Bessie Glasgow of Quothquan is confirmed as executor dative of the deceased John Glasgow, expressly described as her brother. The page then gives the usual authority to administer the estate and records security for proper administration.

The opening is supplied on image 65 in the nested PDF and opening crop. John's debts continue at the top of image 66. These are available originals, not missing pages; full word-by-word transcription remains unfinished.
findings: The surviving confirmation explicitly places John and Bessie Glasgow at Quodquen (modern Quothquan) and calls the deceased John Bessie's brother.
Bessie is executor dative. Her sibling relationship is supported by the express phrase 'John Glasgow hir brother', not inferred merely from her executorial role.
James Carmichael appears in his official capacity as commissary of Lanark; the page does not make him a relative or executor.
